stances_toward.note: From rupture to reset. The 2023 allegation by Trudeau of a possible Indian link to the killing of Hardeep Singh Nijjar and the Oct 2024 mutual expulsion of six diplomats each put the pair at rival level; under Carney both restored high commissioners, restarted trade talks at the Nov 2025 G20 and, on Carney's visit in March 2026, signed a 10-year Cameco uranium supply deal (reported at about USD 1.9bn) with the stated aim of concluding a CEPA by end-2026. The Nijjar case is not formally withdrawn, and the Khalistan question stays Delhi's grievance. Reluctant partner because the thaw is driven by Canadian diversification away from the US, not by a settled trust. Bond - grievance.

Bond - affinity: a large Latvian diaspora in Canada and Canada's non-recognition of the Soviet annexation.

stances_toward.note: NATO and NORAD ally that Washington treats as a target: IEEPA tariffs from 4 Mar 2025, 35% from 1 Aug 2025, talks cancelled over the Reagan advert (Oct 2025), a Section 338 duty of 50% on about USD 20bn of goods from 22 Aug 2026 after talks collapsed, bans on Canadian dairy, motorcycles and alcohol (29 Sep), the USMCA left unrenewed on 1 Jul 2026, Trump calling EU association a possible 'hostile act' and Navarro warning Canada would 'pay even more dearly' over the midterms - plus the '51st state' line Trump said he meant (9 Feb 2025). Reluctant_ally and not rival by the co-member rule; the structure (NORAD, NATO, over 70% of Canadian exports) is untouched while the posture is coercive; Carney told the NYT he has planned for a US invasion. Cooling. Bond - kin: the 51st-state claim is itself a kinship claim; language, border, history. Canada has no card yet; its own side will be written in the reverse pass.
